Falkirk are the outsider as Rangers host them at Ibrox Stadium in round 15 of the Premiership. The odds bookmakers offered on this match give Falkirk a winning probability of 9%.

Current Form - Rangers

Rangers are second on 33 points, with 10 wins, three draws and one loss from 14 league matches and a 26-12 goal record. Their last league match ended in a 3-2 win over Aberdeen, while their last five matches brought four wins and one draw. Rangers have gone 12 matches unbeaten.

Current Form - Falkirk

Falkirk sit third on 24 points, recording seven wins, three draws and four losses from 14 league matches, with 22 goals for and 15 against. Their last league match was a 2-1 win over St Johnstone, and they won all five of their most recent matches. Falkirk have won their last six matches.

Head-to-Head Record

The last five meetings have averaged 4.2 goals. Rangers won three and drew two of their last five meetings against Falkirk. Rangers have won their last three meetings against Falkirk, going back to April 2026. Rangers were unbeaten in their last 13 meetings at home against Falkirk, 10 wins and three draws. Earlier this season, Rangers won 2-1 at Falkirk.

Key Players to Watch and Missing Players

For Rangers, forward Ryan Naderi has seven goals and four assists in 13 games, while Lawrence Shankland has scored three goals, all in his last three matches. Forward Djeidi Gassama has one goal and four assists. Ross McCrorie is a doubt for this match; Daisuke Yokota and Chermiti are unavailable, with groin and knee injuries respectively.

Falkirk's forward Jacob Murrell has eight goals in 12 games, while midfielder Owen Eames has two goals and three assists in 10 games. Midfielder Ethan Ross has two goals and two assists, and Finley Barbrook has scored two goals in his last five matches. Brad Spencer, Leon McCann and Aodhan Doherty are unavailable, while Ryan Strain is unavailable after recording five assists this season.
